entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/02/2024 at 23:03:12 5.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that from a bare perusal of the allegations, as levelled by the complainant, no offence under Section 376 of the IPC is made out against the petitioner.
6.

He submits that the only allegation against the petitioner in the FIR is that the petitioner had physical relations with the complainant, however, it is not alleged that the petitioner had sexual intercourse with the complainant without her consent.

7. He further submits that the complainant in her statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, on a subsequent date, improved upon her statement and made vague allegations that the petitioner had sexual relations with her multiple times on the false pretext of marriage.
8. Issue notice.
9. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the State.

10. On the petitioner taking necessary steps, let notice be issued to Respondent No. 2, through all permissible modes, returnable for 15.05.2024.
11. Reply if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
12. The Investigating Officer is directed to inform the complainant about the next date of hearing.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J FEBRUARY 15, 2024 "hkaur"
